name: Doris Duan Young Autism Center
subject: Special education specialist interested in DDY
body:
Dear DDY team,

A decade of multidisciplinary autism therapy is a strong base, and I would like to be part of it. I am a special education specialist with more than five years of experience with children with autism, and in 2025 I worked in Qatar inside a multidisciplinary team.

Earlier, in Jordan, I managed a resource room, wrote an IEP for every student, and trained shadow teachers and autism teachers.

My CV is attached. I would welcome a conversation about any role on your team.
